key_events_next_24h.name: US June CPI Release (BLS)
key_events_next_24h.note: Headline CPI expected -0.1% MoM (~3.9% YoY) on gasoline drop. Core CPI +0.2% MoM (2.9% YoY). Soft print = short-term bullish; surprise to upside = risk-off sell.

key_events_next_24h.name: Fed Chair Warsh Congressional Testimony
key_events_next_24h.note: Scheduled same day as CPI. Tone on rate path could amplify or offset CPI reaction. Fed on hold at 3.50-3.75% until at least July 29 FOMC.

key_events_next_24h.name: US June PPI Release
key_events_next_24h.note: Secondary inflation gauge; confirms or contradicts CPI read.

key_events_next_24h.name: Fed Beige Book Release
key_events_next_24h.note: Qualitative district survey ahead of July 28-29 FOMC. Low immediate market impact.

market_summary.trend: BTC at ~$62,650, stuck below $63K resistance. Down ~18% for July after June lows of ~$60K.
market_summary.sentiment: Extreme Fear — Fear & Greed Index fell to 22 (down from 28 yesterday). Bearish momentum building.
market_summary.macro: Trump reinstated Iran Hormuz blockade: WTI crude +20% from July low, above $80/barrel. Oil spike raises rate-hike bets, reversing the peace-trade recovery that lifted BTC in early July.
market_summary.etf_flows: Spot BTC ETFs saw -$424M outflows in a single session: BlackRock IBIT -$185M, Fidelity FBTC -$245M. Largest single-day outflow in weeks — institutional demand has reversed sharply.
market_summary.supply_risk: US government transferred ~$300M in seized BTC+ETH (3,940 BTC + 30,014 ETH) to Coinbase Prime — potential market-sell overhead. Whale wallets continue to distribute while retail accumulates.
market_summary.technicals: Price failing to reclaim $63K. Bearish MACD divergence on daily. Bears in control with relief rallies being sold.
market_summary.fed_stance: FOMC on hold at 3.50-3.75%. Next decision July 29. Rate cut odds falling as Iran conflict pushes oil and inflation expectations higher.
